title: Information Thermodynamics of Agents: The Work Capacity of Channels with Memory
abstract: arXiv:2504.06209v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predicting future observations plays a central role in machine learning, biology, economics, and many other fields. It lies at the heart of organizational principles such as the variational free energy principle and, based on the second law of thermodynamics, has even been shown to be necessary for reaching the fundamental energetic limits of information processing on a tape. While the usefulness of the predictive paradigm is undisputed, complex adaptive systems that interact with their environment are more than just predictive machines: they have the power to act upon their environment and cause change. In this work, we develop a framework to analyze the thermodynamics of information processing in percept-action loops, a model of agent-environment interaction, allowing us to investigate the thermodynamic implications of actions and percepts on equal footing. translated_title: 智能体的信息热力学：具有记忆的信道的工作容量
translated_abstract: 预测未来观测在机器学习、生物学、经济学等许多领域中扮演着核心角色。它位于变分自由能原理等组织性原理的核心，并且基于热力学第二定律，甚至已被证明是达到带上信息处理基本能量极限所必需的。尽管预测范式的有效性毋庸置疑，但与环境交互的复杂适应系统不仅仅是预测机器：它们有能力对其环境施加作用并引起改变。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个框架，用于分析感知-动作回路（即智能体-环境交互模型）中信息处理的热力学，使我们能够在平等的地位上研究动作与感知的热力学含义。为此，我们引入了工作容量的概念，其定义为最大……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个分析感知-动作回路中信息处理热力学的框架，并引入“工作容量”这一新概念，使智能体的动作与感知能够在同等地位下研究其热力学效应。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a framework for analyzing the thermodynamics of information processing in percept-action loops, introducing the concept of "work capacity" to study the thermodynamic implications of actions and percepts on equal footing.
